final: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost, AVG(1.0 * derived_total_cost / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio FROM invoice_stats) SELECT AVG(i.avg_product_cost), AVG(i.avg_ratio), AVG(i.avg_ratio - o.overall_avg_ratio) FROM invoice_stats AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND i.avg_ratio > o.overall_avg_ratio
